what: Pre-plan semantic sprawl branch allows Continue despite the feature requiring Split or Cancel with no override at Step 1c/1d.
scenario_or_breakage: When clarifying answers show several sub-features or cross-cutting infrastructure changes, the operator can continue into sketches even though the requirement says this stage should only offer partition or cancellation/refinement.
suggested_fix: Revise the Step 1c/1d plan to use Split and Cancel only; on Cancel run the terminal cost line, print a cancellation message, exit 0, and preserve DESIGN_TMPDIR.

what: --partition is treated as an overridable soft trigger.
scenario_or_breakage: The feature says -p/--partition forces the decomposition panel to run regardless of thresholds, but the plan routes it through the soft branch where Continue with current scope is allowed.
suggested_fix: Make --partition a no-override path: either directly run the interim Split-path hard-fail, or present only Split/Cancel with no Continue until the L3 panel exists.

what: Files-count implementation conflicts with the zero-heading edge case under set -euo pipefail.
scenario_or_breakage: grep -cE returns exit 1 when there are zero matches, so a legacy-format plan with zero headings can abort the helper instead of emitting FILES_COUNT=0 as the plan promises.
suggested_fix: Specify a set -e-safe count, such as FILES_COUNT=$(grep -cE ... "$PLAN_FILE" || true), or use awk; add an explicit zero-heading harness case.

what: Hardcoded Step 5d comment to issue 2672 would ship as permanent runtime behavior.
scenario_or_breakage: After this PR, every successful /design finalize could try to comment on issue #2672 in whatever repo gh targets, causing wrong-repo comments or repeated public noise unrelated to the user's design run.
suggested_fix: Do not add an unconditional runtime Step 5d. Make the #2672 notification an implementation-time/manual task, or gate it narrowly to the larch repo and current issue #2670 with an idempotent sentinel.

what: Public flag surfaces are not included in the plan.
scenario_or_breakage: The plan updates the compact flag table and flags reference, but the command argument hint and skill catalog still omit -p/--partition, so the new public argv flag is discoverability-incomplete.
suggested_fix: Add -p/--partition to the SKILL.md frontmatter argument-hint and the public catalog/README/plugin description surfaces that list /design arguments, or explicitly justify why those generated docs are out of scope.

what: Testing plan omits structural validation for the new public flag and SKILL integration branches.
scenario_or_breakage: The helper harness covers thresholds, but regressions in argv documentation, --trivial mutual exclusion prose, helper invocation after EMIT_PLAN, and hard/soft no-override wording could land without any local harness failing.
suggested_fix: Add grep-style structural pins in test-design-driver.sh or test-design-structure.sh for the -p row, mutual exclusion with --trivial, check-plan-size.sh call after ACTION=EMIT_PLAN, and the no-Continue hard/partition paths.
